observed.databaseError: there is no unique or exclusion constraint matching the ON CONFLICT specification

rootCause: Canonical platform-schema declares no MBW_PERMISSION unique key.
Every canonical MBW_PERMISSION Seed upsert declares the same logical identity: role_code, menu_code, button_code, permission_type, environment_code.
PostgreSQL therefore rejects the first Backoffice Seed ON CONFLICT target.
The later Product Seed also repeats the same MBW_APPROVER/MBW_APPROVAL/DECIDE/API/ALL identity for a retired /actions route and the canonical /decisions route.
A vendor-specific PostgreSQL runtime upsert still targets only role_code, menu_code, button_code, inconsistent with environment-scoped authorization.
architectureDecision: Preserve environment-scoped permission rows and deny-wins authorization. Add the canonical five-column unique identity, retain the separate six-column lookup index, remove only the duplicate retired route Seed row, and align vendor runtime upsert identity. Publish this append-only DB change as a new V136/R136 edge for all official Vendors.
